svg.title: Fold a distribution around its median to find MAD
svg.desc: Area shows reference weight. The upper illustrative curve shows log token counts; its weighted median splits the reference weight in half, with the lower half shaded. Taking absolute distances from the median folds both sides onto the same nonnegative axis. The lower curve combines both sides at equal distances. Its median, which again splits the weight in half, is the MAD; the shaded part lies below it. Both panels share one horizontal scale. The two-peaked shape is illustrative, not measured token data.
